gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the contract been signed than problems arose.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive with inversion: had … been signed.

gaps.sentence: Only now ___ the true cost of the delay becoming clear.
gaps.explanation: 'Only now' + the progressive 'becoming' forces 'is' with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Barely ___ the ink dried when the complaints began to arrive.
gaps.explanation: 'Barely had the ink dried when …' — inverted past perfect.

gaps.sentence: ___ the storm passed did the ferries resume service.
gaps.explanation: Only after/once the storm passed did… — fronted 'only' phrase.

gaps.sentence: Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we left the house ___ it started to pour.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair; 'than' belongs to 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: On no account ___ passengers open this door.
gaps.explanation: On no account should passengers… — formal prohibition.

gaps.sentence: Never have I ___ such a stubborn refusal.
gaps.explanation: Inversion: Never have I + past participle — never adds emphasis.
